reference_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN isodow(order_date) >= 6 THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order
FROM sales
GROUP BY 1
alternatives: SELECT CASE WHEN dayofweek(order_date) IN (0, 6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM sales GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN dayname(order_date) IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM sales GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN dayofweek(order_date) IN (0, 6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM sales GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: dayofweek counts Sunday as 0, so it needs IN (0, 6); isodow keeps Monday 1 to Sunday 7, which is easier to read.
